review: Captured from the source engine, not derived independently. A reviewer checks each case's expected values against its label at step 5 (second review). Values are canonical: n: number, s: text, b: bit, d: date, t: timestamp (microseconds), x: bytes (hex), ∅: NULL.

cases.label: fiscal year = order year + 6 months: 07-01 starts the next year, 06-30 23:59:59.997 does not, 08-31 clamps to 02-28; money sums kept to 4 places; out-of-range years give NULLs; MiddleName NULL leaves two spaces; missing territory, employee or sales person drops the row
